justification: Both surfaces depict raptor-like heads with strongly hooked beaks in profile and spread, feather-marked wings alongside an anthropomorphic figure with a raised arm, plus banded framing/dividing patterns, which is the most specific overlap. But A is a stacked multi-register menagerie of small schematic silhouetted animals (quadrupeds, birds, snakes/waterfowl) with no clear focal actor, while B is a single large bird-headed humanoid holding a bucket and raised cone amid dense rosette borders, rendered with detailed anatomical and textile patterning; the relationships, composition and drawing conventions are essentially unrelated.
